steps: Rinse 180 g quinoa under cold water and cook according to package directions; set aside.
Dice the onion, slice 2 zucchini into half-moons, and dice 2 cooked carrots.
Melt coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat for 1 minute.
Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes, stirring, until translucent.
Add zucchini and cooked carrot; cook for 4 minutes, until slightly softened.
Stir in cooked white beans, turmeric, and ground ginger; cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and unsalted vegetable broth; simmer for 8 minutes, until sauce thickens slightly.
Spoon the white bean and vegetable mixture over the cooked quinoa in bowls.
Serve warm; mash or blend portions for younger babies. Makes 4 bowls · 4 family portions. Refrigerate for up to 3 days.
